info.title: Restaurant Ordering System API
info.description: REST API for managing shops and products in the Restaurant Ordering System

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - Authentication required or insufficient permissions

SubmitContentReportBody.contentUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the reported content. The submit route is public (no sign-in) and the platform console renders this value as a link an operator clicks, so the server accepts nothing else: any other scheme (javascript:, data:, blob:, file:) or a non-absolute URL (relative or protocol-relative) is refused with 400. Omit or send blank to report without a URL.

ContentReport.contentUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL supplied by the reporter, when one was given. Constrained on the write path (see SubmitContentReportBody.contentUrl); rows written before that constraint existed are not migrated.

GET /shops.summary: Get all shops (superadmin only; deleted included)
GET /shops.responseDescription: List of all shops retrieved successfully

GET /shops/me.responseDescription: Shops where the user is an active owner member

GET /shops/public.summary: List the shops shown on the diner home page (not deleted, not offline; public fields only)

GET /shops/{shopId}.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

DELETE /shops/{shopId}.description: Owner (or superadmin) only. Hides the shop but keeps its orders and invoices. Refused with 409 code OPEN_ORDERS while any order is placed, accepted, ready or out for delivery (booked orders included). Cancels the subscription immediately; if that fails nothing is deleted. Deleted shops answer 404.

POST /shops/{shopId}/restore.description: Clears the delete. Does not restart the subscription.

PUT /shops/{shopId}/missed-orders-pause.summary: Set how many unanswered orders in a row pause the shop automatically (superadmin only)
PUT /shops/{shopId}/missed-orders-pause.description: Orders the timer declines because nobody answered them count in a row; when the count reaches this limit the shop is paused until the owner switches it back and the owner is emailed. 0 switches it off; a shop with no value uses 3.

POST /shops/{shopId}/superadmin-offline.summary: Take a shop offline as the platform, or lift it (superadmin only)
POST /shops/{shopId}/superadmin-offline.description: While set, the owner cannot switch the shop online (409 SHOP_OFFLINE_BY_SUPERADMIN on updateShop) and the storefront shows no menu. The owner isPaused flag is untouched.

GET /shops/{shopId}/categories.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/categories/{category.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

POST /shops/{shopId}/categories/{categor.summary: Set every dish in the category to the category's tax class
POST /shops/{shopId}/categories/{categor.description: Bulk fix for a section whose dishes were taxed wrongly. Combos are skipped (taxed per dish inside). Dishes already on the class are left alone.

GET /shops/{shopId}/option-groups/{group.summary: Get an option group by ID

PUT /shops/{shopId}/option-groups/{group.summary: Replace an option group (kind is immutable)

PATCH /shops/{shopId}/option-groups/{gro.summary: Switch one option on or off everywhere it is used

GET /products.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_menu` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

parameters.name: includeUncategorized
parameters.description: Include products that have no category (e.g. dishes created by the bulk menu import)

GET /products/{productId}.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

PATCH /products/{productId}.description: Sending an images array that would leave a dish which has photos with none is refused with 409 code PRODUCT_IMAGE_REQUIRED (body { error, code }); nothing is changed. To replace a photo, add the new one first (POST .../images), then remove the old one.

PATCH /products/{productId}/availability.summary: Mark a dish sold out (or back on sale)
PATCH /products/{productId}/availability.description: Stock-only write: sets isAvailable and/or the sold-out window unavailableUntil (ISO-8601 instant, or null to clear). Nothing else about the dish can be changed here. Allowed with the manage_stock or manage_menu permission. A dish inside its sold-out window stays on the menu marked sold out but cannot be ordered.

POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{productId.summary: Generate upload URL for product image
POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{productId.description: Generates a short-lived SAS URL for uploading product images directly to Azure Blob Storage
Confirms image upload and saves metadata to the product after successful blob storage upload

GET /shops/{shopId}/combos.description: The restaurant combos, sorted by name. Includes images and translations. Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_menu` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

POST /shops/{shopId}/combos.description: Adds a combo. Translations are optional. A combo photo is uploaded like a dish photo: POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{comboId}/images/upload-url, PUT the file (exactly 1200 x 900 px), then POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{comboId}/images. Updates with images omitted keep the existing photo.

PUT /shops/{shopId}/combos/{comboId}.description: Replaces the combo fields as a whole. Group ids sent back are kept. Translation fields left out keep their stored value. A combo photo is uploaded like a dish photo: POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{comboId}/images/upload-url, PUT the file (exactly 1200 x 900 px), then POST /shops/{shopId}/products/{comboId}/images. Updates with images omitted keep the existing photo.

POST /shops/{shopId}/logo/upload-url.summary: Generate upload URL for shop logo
POST /shops/{shopId}/logo/upload-url.description: Generates a short-lived SAS URL for uploading the shop logo directly to Azure Blob Storage

POST /shops/{shopId}/logo.description: Registers the uploaded logo blob URL on the shop. Deletes the previous logo blob if one existed.

DELETE /shops/{shopId}/logo.description: Clears the shop logo (branding.logoUrl) and deletes the stored file. Succeeds without changes if no logo is set.

POST /shops/{shopId}/cover-image/upload-.summary: Generate upload URL for shop cover image
POST /shops/{shopId}/cover-image/upload-.description: Generates a short-lived SAS URL for uploading the shop cover image directly to Azure Blob Storage

POST /shops/{shopId}/cover-image.description: Registers the uploaded cover image on the shop (stored as branding.heroImageUrl). The URL must be the blob returned for this shop by the cover upload URL. Deletes the previous cover blob.

DELETE /shops/{shopId}/cover-image.description: Clears the shop cover image (branding.heroImageUrl) and deletes the stored file. Succeeds without changes if no cover is set.

GET /shops/{shopId}/catalog.summary: Get customer-facing catalog for a shop
GET /shops/{shopId}/catalog.description: Returns every switched-on category with its purchasable products. Categories outside their times right now are included with availableNow false and their schedule. Dishes outside their own schedule are left out. No authentication required. Returns 403 if the shop is currently paused.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Preferred menu language; falls back to the original

POST /orders.summary: Create an order and initiate payment
POST /orders.description: Server recalculates the total from product prices, selected variants, and addons stored in the database. The client-submitted amount is never trusted. Returns a Stripe clientSecret for the frontend to call stripe.confirmPayment().

POST /webhooks/stripe.description: Receives Stripe events (payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed) and updates the order status. Signature is verified using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

GET /shops/{shopId}/orders.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_orders` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of orders per page (default: 20, max: 100)

POST /shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}/re.description: Refunds money already taken for an accepted card order. Send either items (the ticked units, each refunded at its own VAT rate) or amountCents (a free amount, split across the VAT rates in proportion), never both. The reason is internal and never emailed. The diner gets a correction invoice (a cancellation invoice when the first refund covers everything) with the refund email. Needs the refund_orders permission.
POST /shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}/re.responseDescription: Refund recorded; returns the updated order

GET /shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}/doc.summary: Download an invoice or correction invoice (staff or platform operator)
GET /shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}/doc.description: documentId is the order id for the invoice, or the order id followed by -c1, -c2 and so on for correction invoices. A document of another order or restaurant is 404. Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_orders` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

POST /customer-orders/{orderId}/document.summary: Download an invoice or correction invoice (diner)
POST /customer-orders/{orderId}/document.description: The diner proves access with the secret token from the order link. A document of another order is 404.

GET /orders/by-payment-intent/{paymentIn.summary: Get order by Stripe payment intent ID
GET /orders/by-payment-intent/{paymentIn.description: Retrieves order details using the Stripe payment intent ID. The payment intent ID is available on the frontend from stripe.confirmPayment() result or by parsing the clientSecret (format: pi_xxx_secret_xxx). Returns 404 if the order has not yet been created (webhook not yet processed) — poll with back-off until a 200 is returned. Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_orders` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /plans.description: Returns the visible plans for the customer plan selector. A platform operator (Platform.Owner/Support/ReadOnly) may pass includeHidden=true to receive every plan, including those hidden from customers.

parameters.name: includeHidden
parameters.description: Platform operators only: include plans hidden from the customer selector.

GET /platform/content-reports.description: Newest first. Optional status filter: received, actioned, dismissed.

POST /platform/content-reports/{reportId.summary: Record the platform's decision on a content report (platform staff, write)
POST /platform/content-reports/{reportId.description: Records the decision and writes an audit entry. A report can be decided once. Taking the shop down is the separate suspend switch: POST /shops/{shopId}/superadmin-offline.

POST /shops/{shopId}/content-reports.summary: Report illegal content on a storefront (public; no sign-in)
POST /shops/{shopId}/content-reports.description: A reachable notice-and-action path: anyone may report content on a shop's storefront. Anonymous reports are accepted. Returns a receipt (reportId) which is the acknowledgement of receipt.

GET /shops/{shopId}/audit.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_audit` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/legal.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_shop` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/order-limit.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/order-queue.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_orders` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/promotions.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_shop` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/reports/sales.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `view_reports` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/staff.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_staff` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes.

GET /shops/{shopId}/subscription.description: Access: the restaurant's owner or staff with the `manage_billing` permission; platform operators (Platform.Owner, Platform.Support, Platform.ReadOnly) may also read. A read never writes. Never creates the subscription document: a shop without one gets the default plan derived in memory.

GET /shops/{shopId}/realtime/negotiate.description: Returns a Web PubSub client URL and access token (valid 60 minutes) for the hub `orders`, joined to the group named by the shop id. The client receives `{"type":"new-order","orderId":"..."}` and refetches the order queue. Both fields are null when Web PubSub is not configured; the client then keeps polling.

GET /shops/{shopId}/push/public-key.summary: Get the Web Push (VAPID) public key
GET /shops/{shopId}/push/public-key.description: The application server key a browser needs to subscribe to push notifications. `publicKey` is null when push is not configured.

POST /shops/{shopId}/push/subscriptions.summary: Register a device for new-order push notifications
POST /shops/{shopId}/push/subscriptions.description: Stores a browser push subscription for the shop. Idempotent per endpoint; a removed subscription is revived. Answers 503 when push is not configured.

DELETE /shops/{shopId}/push/subscription.summary: Remove a device from new-order push notifications
DELETE /shops/{shopId}/push/subscription.description: Soft-deletes the push subscription with the given endpoint. Succeeds even if it was not registered.
